resolution_notes: base_url: auditor correct. Official Client-Server API is per-homeserver; matrix.org’s .well-known client discovery returns base_url https://matrix-client.matrix.org (https://matrix.org/.well-known/matrix/client). Spec docs use {homeserver}/_matrix/client/v3, not a universal matrix.org/_matrix root (https://spec.matrix.org/latest/client-server-api/). example: auditor correct. Use discovered client base and access token wording, not API key / matrix.org host (same .well-known + whoami path in CS API).
